title: Owners upload a logo that goes out to all their members without being asked if they may use it
what: The branding screen lets an owner upload any picture as the gym logo, and we then store it publicly and show it in every member's app and on the home-screen shortcut. Nowhere on the screen does it say the owner must own or have permission to use that logo, so we could end up shipping someone else's trademark in our app with no record that the gym took responsibility.
expected: A short line next to the upload button (or a tick box the first time) saying the owner confirms the logo is theirs or they have permission to use it, backed by a matching line in the terms.
fix_line: Add one line by the upload button saying the owner confirms they may use this logo, and the same in the terms

items.reason: This area is the owner's web panel (Vite + React), not a Play or Wear OS app: no target API, Play billing, permissions or data safety form here. Play status itself is clean (machine play-report: no policy issues). Branding screen sends no WhatsApp and makes no ad or health claims.
Web panel only; nothing here ships through the App Store.
